"""Fresh raw-corpus comparison against the observed current-main snapshot.

Every row executes both actual recall functions and the candidate helper's
length/idempotence checks. Equal recall bytes have identical en-US extraction.
For legacy, a conservative exact-prelude probe and pure guard observer prove
equality or trigger actual main extraction. Different recalls execute both
actual extractors in both profiles. No previous row/inventory records are read.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import collections
import dataclasses
import functools
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import multiprocessing
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from baseline_ast_proof import Graph

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=HERE.parents[1]
CORPUS=ROOT/'.hub-scratch/r6/corpus'
sys.path.insert(0,str(CORPUS))
from guard_observer import make_observer

MAIN='4f3547461300bfa70569f57c83728b2ad25d9d0b'
SOURCE='harness/source_completeness.py'
VALIDATOR='harness/validator_pipeline.py'
METADATA='harness/manual_locator_metadata.py'


def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def package_hashes(package):
    return {str(path.relative_to(package)):sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in sorted(package.rglob('*.py'))}


def load(name,path):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path)
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[name]=module;spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def normalize(inventory):
    return tuple(dataclasses.asdict(x) for x in inventory)


def semantics(inventory):
    return collections.Counter(json.dumps({key:value for key,value in item.items() if key not in {'raw','start','end'}},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')) for item in inventory)


def delta(before,after):
    removed,added=semantics(before)-semantics(after),semantics(after)-semantics(before)
    if not removed and not added:return None
    old_values,new_values=(collections.Counter(item['value'] for item in xs) for xs in (before,after))
    return {'added_typed':[{'item':json.loads(item),'count':count} for item,count in sorted(added.items())],
        'removed_typed':[{'item':json.loads(item),'count':count} for item,count in sorted(removed.items())],
        'new_demands':sorted(set(new_values)-set(old_values)),'removed_demands':sorted(set(old_values)-set(new_values)),
        'added_occurrences':[{ 'value':value,'count':count} for value,count in sorted((new_values-old_values).items())],
        'removed_occurrences':[{'value':value,'count':count} for value,count in sorted((old_values-new_values).items())]}


def proof(output):
    baseline=Graph(HERE/'current-main-package/src').walk('axiom_encode.harness.validator_pipeline','extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text')
    candidate=Graph(output/'candidate-package/src').walk('axiom_encode.harness.validator_pipeline','extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text')
    changed=sorted(key for key in baseline.keys()&candidate.keys() if baseline[key]!=candidate[key])
    assert changed==['axiom_encode.harness.validator_pipeline:_tokenize_numeric_occurrences_from_text'],changed
    assert baseline.keys()==candidate.keys()
    old_bytes=(HERE/'current-main-package/src/axiom_encode'/VALIDATOR).read_bytes()
    new_bytes=(output/'candidate-package/src/axiom_encode'/VALIDATOR).read_bytes()
    observer,observer_proof=make_observer(old_bytes,new_bytes)
    # Reuse the independently reviewed exact-prelude probe generator. Its
    # old argument is an explicit candidate copy with the main guard restored;
    # dependency-graph equality above binds that tokenizer to actual main.
    from differential_guard_observer_final import numeric_proof
    assignment=("            source_span = cleaned_view.source_span(span)\n"
        "            # Prefer a grouped reading only when this same source token\n"
        "            # supplied it. An unrelated integer (such as a retained page\n"
        "            # number) cannot disambiguate an operative decimal amount.\n")
    conjunct="                    occurrence.span == source_span\n                    and math.isclose(\n"
    text=new_bytes.decode();assert text.count(assignment)==text.count(conjunct)==1
    reverted=text.replace(assignment,'').replace(conjunct,'                    math.isclose(\n').encode()
    probe_proof,probe=numeric_proof(reverted,new_bytes)
    (output/'candidate-with-main-guard.py.txt').write_bytes(reverted)
    (output/'guard-observer.py.txt').write_text(observer+'\n')
    (output/'candidate-probe.py.txt').write_text(probe+'\n')
    result={'baseline_commit':MAIN,'cross_package_dependency_graphs':{'baseline':baseline,'candidate':candidate},
        'only_changed_reachable_declaration':changed,'observer':observer_proof,'probe':probe_proof,
        'probe_old_argument_scope':'Candidate bytes with main guard restored; not relabeled as actual main source.',
        'en_us_equality':'Both dispatch before the changed legacy body into the identical reachable profiled route.',
        'source_sha256':{'main':sha((HERE/'current-main-package/src/axiom_encode'/SOURCE).read_bytes()),'candidate':sha((output/'candidate-package/src/axiom_encode'/SOURCE).read_bytes())},
        'validator_sha256':{'main':sha(old_bytes),'candidate':sha(new_bytes)},
        'metadata_sha256':sha((output/'candidate-package/src/axiom_encode'/METADATA).read_bytes())}
    (output/'pipeline-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    return result


def initialize(output):
    global BASELINE,CANDIDATE,EXTRACT_MAIN,EXTRACT_CANDIDATE,HELPER,PROBE,OBSERVE
    output=Path(output)
    # The inert probe-generator dependency adds its historical repository
    # source root to sys.path. Restore the authenticated baseline package
    # before importing any executable baseline module.
    sys.path.insert(0,str(HERE/'current-main-package/src'))
    from axiom_encode.harness import source_completeness as baseline
    from axiom_encode.harness import validator_pipeline as validator
    expected_main=(HERE/'current-main-package/src/axiom_encode').resolve()
    assert Path(baseline.__file__).resolve()==expected_main/SOURCE
    assert Path(validator.__file__).resolve()==expected_main/VALIDATOR
    BASELINE=functools.lru_cache(maxsize=256)(lambda body,citation:baseline.authoritative_numeric_recall_text(body,corpus_citation_path=citation))
    package=output/'candidate-package/src/axiom_encode'
    load('axiom_encode.harness.manual_locator_metadata',package/METADATA)
    candidate=load('axiom_encode.harness.final_corpus_candidate_source',package/SOURCE)
    original=candidate._without_us_manual_locators
    @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=256)
    def helper(body,citation):
        masked=original(body,corpus_citation_path=citation)
        assert len(masked)==len(body)
        assert original(masked,corpus_citation_path=citation)==masked
        return masked,sum(a.isdigit() and a!=b for a,b in zip(body,masked))
    HELPER=helper
    candidate._without_us_manual_locators=lambda body,*,corpus_citation_path:helper(body,corpus_citation_path)[0]
    CANDIDATE=functools.lru_cache(maxsize=256)(lambda body,citation:candidate.authoritative_numeric_recall_text(body,corpus_citation_path=citation))
    current=load('axiom_encode.harness.final_corpus_candidate_validator',package/VALIDATOR)
    assert Path(current.__file__).resolve()==(package/VALIDATOR).resolve()
    EXTRACT_MAIN=functools.lru_cache(maxsize=256)(lambda text,profile:normalize(validator.extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text(text,profile=profile)))
    EXTRACT_CANDIDATE=functools.lru_cache(maxsize=256)(lambda text,profile:normalize(current.extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text(text,profile=profile)))
    exec(compile((output/'candidate-probe.py.txt').read_text(),'<exact-prelude-probe>','exec'),vars(current))
    PROBE=functools.lru_cache(maxsize=256)(current._audit_legacy_condition_has_candidate)
    exec(compile((output/'guard-observer.py.txt').read_text(),'<pure-guard-observer>','exec'),vars(current))
    @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=256)
    def observe(text):
        tokenization,diverged=current._audit_legacy_tokenization_and_guard_divergence(text)
        return normalize(tokenization.inventory),diverged
    OBSERVE=observe


def observer_smoke(output):
    initialize(str(output.resolve()))
    cases=['12.25','1225 $12.25 per hour','1225\n$12.25 per hour',
        'Fees in dollars (required)\n214.03 Application Process\n214.04 Retroactive Applications',
        'The month shown below determines eligibility.\n032-03-0445-01 (07/2026)',
        '1.250 dollars and 12.50 dollars','In 2026 amounts were $2,026 and $20.26.',
        '12.25% applies to 1225 dollars','12.25 per hour and 1225 dollars',
        'Table 1: $2,474 2 $2,909','Table 1: Household size 1 100 size 2 200']
    results=[]
    for source in cases:
        observed,diverged=OBSERVE(source)
        actual=EXTRACT_CANDIDATE(source,'legacy')
        baseline=EXTRACT_MAIN(source,'legacy')
        assert observed==actual
        if not diverged:assert actual==baseline
        results.append({'source_sha256':sha(source.encode()),'diverged':diverged,'matches_actual_candidate':True,
            'matches_actual_main_when_no_divergence':not diverged})
    assert any(row['diverged'] for row in results)
    report={'cases':len(results),'all_assertions_passed':True,'runtime_package_bindings_verified':True,'results':results}
    (output/'observer-smoke.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'observer_smoke_cases':len(results),'all_assertions_passed':True}),flush=True)


def evaluate(task):
    file,number,raw=task;row=json.loads(raw);body=row.get('body') or '';citation=row['citation_path']
    masked,digits=HELPER(body,citation)
    if not citation.startswith('us'):assert masked==body
    old=BASELINE(body,citation);new=CANDIDATE(body,citation)
    result={'file':file,'line':number,'citation':citation,'row_sha256':sha(raw),
        'helper_sha256':sha(masked.encode()),'helper_masked_digit_count':digits,'helper_length_and_idempotence':True,
        'recall_sha256':{'main':sha(old.encode()),'candidate':sha(new.encode())},'changes':{}}
    if old!=new:
        result['proof']='different_recall_actual_both_profiles'
        for profile in ('en-US','legacy'):
            before,after=EXTRACT_MAIN(old,profile),EXTRACT_CANDIDATE(new,profile)
            change=delta(before,after)
            if change:result['changes'][profile]=change
        return result
    if not PROBE(new):
        result['proof']='equal_recall_identical_en_us_and_no_legacy_guard_candidate'
        return result
    after,diverged=OBSERVE(new)
    result['proof']='equal_recall_actual_current_legacy_no_guard_divergence'
    if diverged:
        result['proof']='equal_recall_guard_divergence_actual_both_legacy'
        change=delta(EXTRACT_MAIN(old,'legacy'),after)
        if change:result['changes']['legacy']=change
    return result


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--output',required=True,type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--workers',type=int,choices=(1,2,4),default=4);parser.add_argument('--limit',type=int,default=0)
    args=parser.parse_args();output=args.output;output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    package=output/'candidate-package/src/axiom_encode'
    shutil.copytree(ROOT/'src/axiom_encode',package,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__','*.pyc'))
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','origin/main'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()==MAIN
    started=time.monotonic();baseline_hashes=package_hashes(HERE/'current-main-package/src/axiom_encode')
    print(json.dumps({'stage':'dependency_and_guard_proofs_started'}),flush=True)
    pipeline=proof(output);observer_smoke(output)
    manifest=json.loads((CORPUS/'corpus-manifest.json').read_text())
    assert len(manifest)==231 and sum(info['rows'] for info in manifest)==68848
    print(json.dumps({'stage':'fresh_rows_started','expected_rows':68848,'expected_files':231,'workers':args.workers}),flush=True)
    expected=set();returned=set();proofs=collections.Counter();metrics={profile:collections.Counter() for profile in ('en-US','legacy')}
    def tasks():
        for info in manifest:
            data=(CORPUS/'input'/info['file']).read_bytes();assert sha(data)==info['sha256']
            rows=data.splitlines();assert len(rows)==info['rows']
            for number,raw in enumerate(rows,1):
                if not raw.strip():continue
                if args.limit and len(expected)>=args.limit:return
                key=info['file'],number;assert key not in expected;expected.add(key)
                yield info['file'],number,raw
    with (output/'rows.jsonl').open('w') as stream,(output/'deltas.jsonl').open('w') as deltas,multiprocessing.Pool(args.workers,initialize,(str(output.resolve()),)) as pool:
        for row in pool.imap_unordered(evaluate,tasks(),chunksize=1):
            key=row['file'],row['line'];assert key not in returned;returned.add(key);proofs[row['proof']]+=1
            stream.write(json.dumps(row,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
            if row['changes']:deltas.write(json.dumps(row,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
            for profile,change in row['changes'].items():
                count=metrics[profile];count['changed_rows']+=1
                for kind in ('new_demands','removed_demands'):count[kind]+=len(change[kind])
                for kind in ('added_occurrences','removed_occurrences'):count[kind]+=sum(x['count'] for x in change[kind])
                for kind in ('added_typed','removed_typed'):count[kind]+=sum(x['count'] for x in change[kind])
            if len(returned)%500==0:
                stream.flush();deltas.flush();assert stream.tell()+deltas.tell()<1_000_000_000
                print(json.dumps({'rows':len(returned),'proofs':dict(proofs),'comparisons':metrics,'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,2)}),flush=True)
    assert expected==returned and len(returned)==(args.limit or 68848)
    assert package_hashes(HERE/'current-main-package/src/axiom_encode')==baseline_hashes
    for name in (SOURCE,VALIDATOR,METADATA):assert (ROOT/'src/axiom_encode'/name).read_bytes()==(package/name).read_bytes()
    summary={'complete':True,'rows':len(returned),'input_files':len(manifest),'full_corpus':not args.limit,
        'baseline_commit':MAIN,'corpus_commit':'8f7d60aaced28ee4252b9237f9d6e02360dc34bc','source_sha256':pipeline['source_sha256'],
        'validator_sha256':pipeline['validator_sha256'],'metadata_sha256':pipeline['metadata_sha256'],
        'comparisons':{profile:dict(count) for profile,count in metrics.items()},'proof_counts':dict(proofs),
        'previous_records_read':0,'input_manifest_sha256':sha((CORPUS/'corpus-manifest.json').read_bytes()),
        'baseline_package_sha256':baseline_hashes,'baseline_package_unchanged_at_completion':True,
        'output_sha256':{name:sha((output/name).read_bytes()) for name in ('rows.jsonl','deltas.jsonl','pipeline-proof.json')},
        'runner_sha256':sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),'workers':args.workers,'python':sys.version,
        'threads':{key:os.environ.get(key) for key in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS','NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS','OMP_WAIT_POLICY')},
        'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}
    (output/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n');print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,sort_keys=True),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()
